title: Returns
body: Unused items can be returned within 30 days of delivery. Include the order number and original packaging.

title: Delivery
body: Standard UK delivery takes three working days. Tracking is emailed when the parcel leaves the warehouse.

title: Warranty
body: Manufacturing defects are covered for 12 months from purchase. Accidental damage is excluded.

title: Billing
body: VAT invoices are available in the order history. Download the PDF invoice after payment clears.

title: Account access
body: Use the password reset link on the sign-in page. The reset email expires after 20 minutes.

title: Order cancellation
body: You can cancel an order before dispatch. Contact support with the order number to request cancellation.
